messages.subject: Solved: qqline
parts:
Hi,

I fiddled around some more and found a solution. Here it is:

>>
p <- ggplot(subset(d.molten, variable%in%c("pcu","pcl","anu","anl")), aes(sample=value))

slope <- function(x){(quantile(x, p=.75)-quantile(x,.25))/(qnorm(.75)-qnorm(.25))}

d.qqline <- cast(d.molten, variable~., fun=function(x){
list(slope=slope(x),
intercept=quantile(x,.25)-slope(x)*qnorm(.25))},
subset=variable%in%c("pcu","pcl","anu","anl"))

pg <- p + geom_point(stat="qq") + facet_wrap(~variable) + theme_bw()

pg + geom_abline(data=d.qqline, aes(intercept=intercept, slope=slope))
<<

Maybe someone can benefit from this.

Best,
Paul
